_comment: Community setup pass (2026-11-03): facts the readers took from the communities' own channels and the Community Beastmen maintainer's guide, for the setups in community-setups.json.

relations+.note: Makes the matched animations happen more often (maintainer's guide)
Faster travel to the quest targets
More Beastmen legendary lords to confederate; do not start as one of them, or the mod's Beastmen content is missing
Lets the corrupted heroes use corruption-stage reskins
The maintainer's guide gives console commands to spawn the corrupted heroes and lords when a mission breaks
No other animation mods: they conflict with the Beastmen animations (maintainer's guide)
No other animation mods: they conflict with the Beastmen animations (maintainer's guide)
A Warmaidens reskin of the Beastmen themselves; use the separate Warmaidens packs of other factions only

installNotes+: Two versions: new_community_beastmen.pack (Steam 3476784883 and LoversLab) only for Khazrak, Malagor, Taurox and Morghur campaigns; community_beastmen_light.pack (LoversLab only) with just the reskins and animations, for any faction. The full version in another faction's campaign brings missing mounts, overwritten texts and no confederation.
Endo's matched (sex) animations are part of the mod; they play on infantry on foot only, not on mounted or fleeing models and not for lord abilities. More Animation makes them happen more often.

Place it at the top of the load order. With the full version, do not use the all-in-one Total Warmaidens pack (separate faction packs are fine), Slaanesh vassalisation mods, overhauls such as SFO or 'Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords' - they break its missions; the light version is fine with them.
The LoversLab page holds a text file with Google Drive links, and its date does not change when the files are updated; LoversLab is usually ahead of Steam.
Console commands for broken missions (spawn the corrupted heroes and lords, trigger the final missions) are in the maintainer's guide: https://github.com/RealDeHess/CommunityBeastmen
knownIssues+: The rites screen does not scroll while a lord is selected: deselect the lord and open it again (maintainer's guide).
Hellebron's quest battle lies off the map and crashes when teleporting there in the Steam build; fixed in the LoversLab files (author, 2026-07-08).

relations+.note: Lewd matched battle animations for orcs, goblins and trolls; not yet confirmed for patch 9.0
Players use it with Greenskin lords to corrupt and confederate defeated female legendary lords

installNotes+: Standalone: it contains Endo's goblin mod, Tacomarine's addon and Elvslayer's events, so none of the older goblin packs are needed. Fixed for patch 9.0 on 2026-09-29 and after the hotfix on 2026-10-04 (author).
